$ qm "list"
exit 0
--- stdout
No work items yet. Create one with: qm new TITLE

$ qm "new" "Fix login bug" "--project" "demo" "--branch" "feat/a" "--description" "Line one"
exit 0

--- fix-login-bug.md
---

title: Fix login bug
state: in_progress

created: 'DATE'
branches:
- feat/a
